result_summary.title: Broken Sorting and Filtering in Status Page (US-West Dev)
result_summary.description: The sorting and filtering features on the Status Page in our US-West development environment are not working correctly. Queries return inconsistent results or no results at all. This is affecting approximately 1,000 users. We believe this is due to insufficient capacity planning for the backend database, leading to query failures under load. Please check the server resources and database capacity.
